'''So Eban''' is a village in [[Altara]]. It is located on the border of Altara and [[Amadicia]], near the [[River Eldar]].

When [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Juilin Sandar]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] are in [[Sienda]], Thom hears of a rumor that King [[Ailron]] means to take the eastern bank of the River Eldar, from [[Salidar]] to So Eban to [[Mosra]]. If this plan succeeds, [[Pedron Niall]], through Ailron, will be able to control the commerce of [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|5|16}}
